answer: A bond of 36% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in relic, and nadir reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 58 aliases, and each one needs its own funded dawn account. Repeating the trick 9 times costs 59 separate deposits and 42 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
